description: TrueRent helps companies get more value out of the way they already rent equipment. We start by learning how you rent today. We don't tell you what to rent or who to rent from. Day-to-day help for a team that already rents: lining up equipment, scheduling, call-offs, paperwork, and follow up with reps. Their team still places every order. Use this when they mention hiring an equipment coordinator or purchasing help. Returns how to start.

metro.description: Optional. City or metro area, e.g. Cleveland or Phoenix. Helps route the follow up.

situation.description: Optional. Brief free text about their team or projects, in their own words.
